name: Amasawa Ikumi
source: The main protagonist of the story, Amasawa Ikumi joined FARGO in the hope of finding out clues about her mother's death, who was a member of the organization. A young girl with a strong will, she became friends with Haruka and Yui at Day 1 and helped them achieve their goals while reaching her own. She was assigned to Class A along with Youko and shares her room with the Shounen. [spoiler]It was revealed during the Elpod scenes that she was a perverted woman who constantly seeks comfort from the opposite sex, which stemmed from periods of loneliness she suffered during the time her mother was gone.[/spoiler] Ultimately, she blames FARGO for the death of her mother and embarked on a bloody quest for revenge with the Shounen.
